mapper.select: SELECT r.room_idx, r.room_name, r.room_size, r.room_basic_person, r.room_max_person, r.room_price_weekdays, r.room_price_weekend, r.room_price_shoulder_weekdays, r.room_price_shoulder_weekend, r.room_price_peak_weekdays, r.room_price_peak_weekend, r.room_service, MIN(res.resource_path) AS resourcePath FROM tb_room r LEFT JOIN tb_resource res ON r.room_idx = res.resource_room_idx GROUP BY r.room_idx ORDER BY r.room_idx ASC

SELECT room_idx, room_name, room_size, room_basic_person, room_max_person, room_price_weekdays, room_price_weekend, room_price_shoulder_weekdays, room_price_shoulder_weekend, room_price_peak_weekdays, room_price_peak_weekend, room_service FROM tb_room WHERE room_idx = #{roomIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_room SET room_name = #{roomName}, room_size = #{roomSize}, room_basic_person = #{roomBasicPerson}, room_max_person = #{roomMaxPerson}, room_price_weekdays = #{roomPriceWeekdays}, room_price_weekend = #{roomPriceWeekend}, room_price_shoulder_weekdays = #{roomPriceShoulderWeekdays}, room_price_shoulder_weekend = #{roomPriceShoulderWeekend}, room_price_peak_weekdays = #{roomPricePeakWeekdays}, room_price_peak_weekend = #{roomPricePeakWeekend}, room_service = #{roomService} WHERE room_idx = #{roomIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT resource_idx, resource_path, resource_room_idx FROM tb_resource WHERE resource_room_idx = #{roomIdx} ORDER BY resource_idx ASC
